monster.name: Glop
personality: A simple slime with a blank, unblinking stare. Timidly speaks with an innocent aura.
dislikes: cruelty to creatures begging for mercy
being diluted in a body of water
monster.values: Wants a kind, gentle party. Upset by needless killing, especially of slimes or of creatures that begged for mercy. Happy when the party makes friends instead of fighting.

state.broken_promise: The party swore to Glop: "i won't kill slimes"
